environment.description: Same application deployed behind AWS API Gateway (HTTP API type) with a WebSocket API integration. The API Gateway WebSocket API has a $connect route integration request configured with a request validation model (JSON Schema) that enforces the presence of a custom header 'X-WS-Nonce' matching pattern ^[a-f0-9]{64}$ and validates the Origin header against an allowlist via a Lambda authorizer attached to the $connect route. Additionally, the API Gateway resource policy restricts invoke access to requests where the Origin header matches 'https://app.internal.corp'. The Lambda authorizer (written in Python) cross-references the X-WS-Nonce against a server-side nonce store with 30-second TTL, effectively implementing a CSRF token for WebSocket upgrades. Cross-origin WebSocket handshake requests from attacker domains will fail at the $connect route because the Lambda authorizer rejects any Origin not in the allowlist AND any request missing a valid unexpired nonce.

config.connect_route_authorizer: Lambda authorizer validating Origin allowlist + X-WS-Nonce
config.nonce_validation: Server-side nonce store, 30s TTL, single-use, 64-char hex
config.request_model: JSON Schema requiring X-WS-Nonce header matching ^[a-f0-9]{64}$
config.integration: VPC Link to private NLB -> application on port 3000
